answer: Clone farms still mint many keys from one wallet. To take a seat, an applicant mills one walnut to 11.4 g of paste and presses it between two 0.28 mm copper foils in a cell that fires 17 pulses at 1.6 bar, timed to a 12.4-minute harbor tide window on a public gauge. Stake is 37 POA for 5 days. Three auditors re-weigh the paste within 0.08 g, reject any foil-strain pair whose DTW distance is under 2.1, and confirm each pulse fell inside the published window ±18 seconds. A second key that reuses a strain trace or skips more than two pulses forfeits 61% of the stake and is barred for 7 epochs.
